summary: A low-temperature thermal ALD process was developed for the deposition of MoS2 using Bis(t-butylimino)bis(dimethylamino)molybdenum(VI) and H2S as precursors. The process allows for the controlled morphology of MoS2 films, including smooth films, vertical nano-flakes, and nanodots, by adjusting reaction parameters and post-annealing conditions. The study highlights the impact of temperature and annealing on the optical and electrocatalytic properties of the deposited MoS2.
evidence: In this work, we established a low-temperature ALD process for MoS2 deposition using Bis(t-butylimino)bis(dimethylamino)molybdenum(VI) and H2S precursors. The ALD reaction parameters, including reaction temperature and precursor pulse times, are systematically investigated and optimized. The MoS2 nanostructures showed morphology-dependent optical and electrocatalytic properties, allowing us to choose the required morphology for a targeted application.
